programme.title: Sevanthi
programme.desc: Sevanthi is daily family entertainment serial in Udaya TV. Arjun and Anuradha both are grandchildren of Pramoda Devi. The family is wanting the duo to get hitched and their closeness has generated such emotion in the hearts of family members. However, because of tragedy befell on family of Anuradha, She end up growing as Sevanthi at an Ashram (orphanage) run by Shantamurthy. The Ashram one day lands in trouble as Sakshi, hailing from an elite family conspires to take over. To safeguard the ashram, Sevanthi approaches Arjun. The popular advocate Arjun put pre-condition of contractual marriage with her, only if Sevanthi agrees to that, he says, he will protect the Ashram. What would happen if a boy who has no belief in relationship and love marries a girl who lives breathing love and care is the knot of the tale.

programme.desc: Kamuti is a wise old leopard who has reigned over two square miles of prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for ten years, but now she is in trouble. Kamuti's problems are compounded by her neighbours, the Nsefu pride of lions, who steal her kills and attack her on sight.

programme.sub-title: As the Delhi heat rises in full force, tempers rise with it. Sameer tries to push himself to perform his poetry for an audience that isn't Lloyd, while Avi tries to drown his sorrows by pretending like he's completely fine. Tensions implode and so do Gandhi's... special parts.

programme.sub-title: Avi has the greatest plan (his words) to move on and spend time with himself - an Imtiaz Ali-themed tour of Delhi. What could go wrong? Meanwhile, Gandhi's first day of cricket practice doesn't quite go as planned, and Lakshay meets an unexpected acquaintance.

programme.desc: focusing on a mysterious property dispute involving a last will and testament

programme.title: MG24
programme.desc: �high-stakes suspense thriller featuring a story that intertwines the lives of four friends, each facing personal crises that lead into a lethal mystery.

programme.title: Web
programme.desc:
Four girls are kidnapped while returning from a rave party. They were drunk and driving rashly. They wake up to find themselves tied up in a secluded and unkempt bunglow. There is a fifth girl who has been tortured since long. Brutally beaten. The torture begins for these 4 girls. The man and woman who keep them hostage have CCTVs installed in the room where these girls are kept. Thus whenever they try to run away, or make any move are captured back. These goes on for days and then one day the kidnapper kills one of the girl's and feeds her to his dog, as she finds out that her husband has also been killed by the same man.
Later, the woman assisting the kidnapper reveals his story to these girls. The kidnapper had a sister, and she gets killed by a rash driving. Thus anyone who is driving irresponsibly will have to pay the price.
Towards the end these 3 girls manage to escape and reach their homes, only to discover that the kidnapper was actually one of the leading psychiatrist and was requested by their parents to treat the daughters from alcohol and drug abuse and addiction.
Since the traditional methods were tried earlier and lack of cooperation from patients yield no results, thus they reached out to this doctor.
Hence the doctor along with his colleagues & the two friends (whom were thought to have been killed) devise a 21 days treatment plan & everything was just part of it.

programme.title: Kaarotiyin kadhali
programme.desc: Chandran, a fiercely loyal cab driver who works exclusively for a wealthy Singaporean businessman named Siva. When Chandran gets entangled in the shady, dangerous internal affairs of his employer, their trusting relationship faces an unexpected turning point

programme.title: Kezhapaya
programme.desc: a stubborn 60-year-old watchman, Sundaresan, who refuses to move his bicycle from the middle of a narrow road when confronted by a car, leading to a standoff with the occupants and a growing crowdSundaresan, a robust and medication-free 60-year-old, works as a watchman. When a car confronts him on a narrow road, he refuses to yield, leading to a confrontation that baffle his family.

programme.title: Thottal thodarum
programme.desc: Madhu falls in love with Shiva, an HR executive. When her stepbrother is hospitalised, she switches her photo with a reporter in order to get killed and help her family with her insurance money.

programme.title: Jenni
programme.desc: a 9-year-old boy, Chandru, who finds a haunted, traditional wooden doll at a construction site. Against his parents' wishes, he keeps it, triggering terrifying paranormal events as the doll, possessed by a murdered child, attempts to avenge her death

programme.title: Unnal ennal
programme.desc: Three youths come to Chennai in search of livelihood from the village due to poverty. The need for money chases them, and in a way comes an opportunity to run out of their need for money.

programme.title: Sotta sotta nanaiyuthu
programme.desc: Insecure about his baldness, wealthy Raja finds love with kind-hearted Priya. As family pushes him toward modern-minded Shruti, he must choose between following his heart and meeting society's expectations.

programme.title: Rail
programme.desc: In a rapidly urbanizing village, Muthiah, an electrician and habitual drinker, struggles with his marriage and work. His hatred for North Indian workers leads to conflict with his neighbor, Sunil

programme.title: Vaanaran
programme.desc: After losing Sumathi, Anumandrao raises Ammu alone; when she falls ill, he fights to save her.

programme.title: Ree
programme.desc: The film follows Reema, who finds her new home haunted, only for a deeper, thriller-oriented mystery to unfold involving neighbors and past vendettas.

programme.title: Kadukka
programme.desc: In a peaceful village, two best friends find themselves falling for the same girl, turning their friendship into a light-hearted rivalry. As they each try to win her heart in their own quirky ways, unexpected twists and playful misunderstandings add to the chaos. But the girl has a secret that could change everything, leading to a surprising outcome. Interestingly the girl loving the two boys simultaneously and express her love equally to both of them leading to a conflict and the climax is shown with a good interesting suspenseful message.

programme.title: Kufr
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar says we humans are so caught up in our personal lives that we don't realise the entire world is flooded with many problems. We talk about them for some time & then go back to our normal lives.

programme.title: Guncha
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar says our lives are moving so quickly that the destinations are being left far behind. In this fast-paced life we need to take breaks more often to enjoy the small moments of lives.

programme.title: Raat
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar says in olden times a qasid i.e. messenger used to deliver messages across villages. People used to deliver their messages to each other through these messengers which arose the essence of life.
